facts.command:

PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
LC_ALL=C
export LC_ALL
as_root() {
  if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$@"
  else
    sudo -n "$@"
  fi
}
as_root sh -s <<'LEGACY2_BASELINE_SH'
set -eu
cd '/srv/legacy2/mysql-relational-import'
printf '%s\n' 'SHA256 (regular files only)'
